mass_convention_provenance.recorded_primary_excerpt: By default, masses are in solar masses of stars formed
mass_convention_provenance.interpretation: Paper labels total stellar mass without specifying conversion; Prospector defaults to formed mass. Author configuration/posterior mass conversion is unavailable; neither convention is assumed confirmed.

published_model_sfr_and_halfmass_benchma.window_definition_assumed: means over nested trailing 5/50-Myr windows including zero SFR before modeled onset; exact author postprocessing is unavailable
published_model_sfr_and_halfmass_benchma.halfmass_definition_assumed: lookback time enclosing half the cumulative formed mass; constant effective return makes it also half the surviving mass. Exact author postprocessing is unavailable.

assumptions: both current surviving and cumulative formed interpretations of the quoted model-dependent stellar mass are evaluated; neither is asserted to be the author's reporting convention
freezing the same quoted mass across alternative histories is a sensitivity experiment, not a stellar-population refit; mass-to-light ratios must be refitted for real likelihoods
null e-fold time means constant SFR; finite positive times mean a rising exponential envelope
duty is a uniformly interleaved active fraction multiplying the envelope integral; contiguous burst histories need their actual integration
active SFR predictions condition on observing an active phase; duty is not automatically the probability of UV selection
returned fraction is an uncalibrated effective integrated parameter; an age-dependent stellar return kernel is required for physical fitting
recent complete assembly windows are counterfactual tests of forming all surviving stellar mass in that interval, not observed stellar ages
closed-parcel baryon accounting permits returned gas to recycle, assumes permanent outflow loss and no later external inflow or ex-situ stars
available baryon fraction refers to the initial retained cosmic allowance, separate from later wind loss
gas masses and halo masses are hypothetical sensitivity inputs, not measured quantities
polluter initial mass fractions are conditional event-equivalent bookkeeping, not IMF constraints or star formation rates for the polluter itself
